verification.method: scripts/verify/ukraine.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100 (every year from 2020), rank 2026/2100, share, growth, density, land area; 1993 peak and about a quarter lower now; second in Eastern Europe after Russia
Natural decrease every year since 1991 and the steepest relative natural decrease among countries above 5 million; births 1960 peak vs 2026
Net migration 2022 (largest single-year net outflow of any country in the UN estimates), 2024 and 2025 inflows, 2026
Fertility 0.90 in 2022 (lowest in Europe that year), 1.00 now, under 2.1 every year since 1987
Poland larger in 2023–2024 and from 2042; 2050/2100 totals; median age 2026/2100
2001 census and UNFPA's call for a new census against UNFPA EECA, 'Ukraine's demographic challenges deepen amidst ongoing war' (22 October 2024, read 2026-11-25)
Title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 77 of 77 checks match
